generation.symbolPrompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one original professional app logo SYMBOL ONLY for 零幕 / ZEROMU, a personal AI filmmaking and visual storyboard canvas application. Concept: from zero to the first scene. Design a distinctive geometric abstract Z formed from two offset cinematic rectangular frame segments connected by one bold diagonal ribbon; the open negative spaces suggest framing a shot and moving a story forward. It must read as one cohesive sophisticated mark, not a stack of unrelated icons. Flat vector-like construction, meticulously consistent geometry, subtle controlled rounded corners, broad strong silhouette, optically balanced, crisp edges, clear at small app-icon sizes. Use deep ink teal #12343B as the main color with a restrained vivid mint #29D7B0 accent on one terminal/frame segment. A compact nearly square symbol centered with generous transparent padding, occupying about 68% of the square image. Transparent background, no backdrop tile, no white panel, no shadows, no gradients, no 3D, no texture, no mockup, no lens details, no film perforations, no play-button triangle, no sparkles, no robot, no letters or wordmark or text other than the abstract shape of Z. Render one single final symbol, no variants, no brand presentation sheet.

Keep clear space between symbol and lettering, optical balance, logo symbol height equal to the entire two-line wordmark block. Colors: symbol as reference; all lettering solid deep ink teal #12343B. Flat crisp vector-like identity artwork. Transparent background. Wide horizontal image around 2:1, composition centered with safe margins on all four sides, the full lockup occupies 80% of image width. No slogan, no website, no secondary examples, no presentation board, no business card or wall mockups, no drop shadow, no 3D, no decorative elements. Preserve real alpha transparency.
